blocks.text: 1923 mein Washington University mein Arthur Holly Compton ne graphite target ke loosely bound (dheele bandhe) electrons se X-rays ki scattering (bikharna) ko study kiya (Fig. 18.5). Unhon ne asal direction (simt) se angle θ par scattered (bikhri hui) X-rays ki wavelength napi. Pata chala ke scattered X-rays ki wavelength λs incident (aane wali) X-rays ki wavelength λi se zyada hai. Ise Compton effect kehte hain. Classical wave theory wavelength ke is increase (izafe) ki explanation nahi de saki. Is liye Compton ne kaha ke X-rays photons se bani hain jin ki energy hc/λ aur momentum h/λ hai.

blocks.alt: X-ray source X-rays ko slits se guzarta hai. Lambda i wavelength ka photon graphite target C se takrata hai; lambda s wavelength ka scattered photon asal direction se angle theta par nikal kar mude hue scale par chalne wale detector tak pohanchta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.5: Compton ka scattering experiment (kitab ki Figure 18.5 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Compton shift
Ab wavelength ki tabdeeli Δλ ka formula nikalte hain; ise Compton shift kehte hain.
Photon aur electron ki collision (takkar) ko billiard ki do gendon ki takkar ki tarah samjhein. Fig. 18.6 mein ek X-ray photon aur shuru mein rest par para electron takra rahe hain.

blocks.alt: Incident photon (E = hc/lambda, p = h/lambda) rest mein target electron se takrata hai. Scattered photon (E = hf', p = h/lambda') axis se angle theta oopar aur scattered electron (K.E. = (m - mo)c^2, p = mv) angle phi neeche jata hai. Dotted lines components (hisse) dikhati hain: h/lambda' cos theta, h/lambda' sin theta, mv cos phi aur mv sin phi.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.6: X-ray photon aur rest mein electron ki collision (takkar) (kitab ki Figure 18.6 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Collision se pehle sara momentum (h/λ) asal direction mein hai. Baad mein photon aur electron ke momentum ke horizontal components (ufqi hisse) (h/λ′ cos θ aur mv cos φ) mil kar h/λ ke barabar hain, aur vertical components (amudi hisse) (h/λ′ sin θ oopar, mv sin φ neeche) aik doosre ko cancel (khatam) karte hain.

Energy hf = hc/λ wala X-ray photon rest par pare electron se takrata hai. Collision mein photon apni kuch energy electron ko de deta hai. Photon asal direction se angle θ par kam energy hf′ = hc/λ′ ke saath bikhar jata hai, aur electron angle φ par recoil karta (peeche hatta) hai. Electron ki K.E. = (m − m₀)c² hai, jahan m velocity v se chalte electron ka mass aur m₀ us ka rest mass hai. Collision ke baad electron ki total (kul) energy (mc²) aur pehle ki energy (m₀c²) ka farq hi electron ki K.E. hai.
Asal mein yeh do gendon ki elastic collision ka seedha sa sawal hai: energy aur momentum dono conserve (qaim) rehte hain. Energy ke conservation se:

blocks.text_alt: Change in photon energy = K.E. of electron

blocks.text: Momentum vector hai, is liye x aur y dono components alag alag conserve hote hain. x-component (photon ki asal direction) mein: shuru ka momentum = aakhri momentum. Shuru mein sirf photon ka momentum h/λ hai (electron rest par):

blocks.text_alt: h/λ + 0 = (h/λ′) cos θ + mv cos φ

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab x-momentum wali equation mein scattered photon ka term (h/λ) cos θ chhapti hai. Scatter hone ke baad photon ki wavelength λ′ hai, is liye sahi (h/λ′) cos θ hai, jaisa y-component wali equation aur Fig. 18.6 mein hai.

y-component (asal direction ke perpendicular) mein: shuru mein y-momentum zero tha, is liye baad mein photon ka oopar wala hissa aur electron ka neeche wala hissa barabar ho kar ek doosre ko khatam karte hain:
In equations ko hal karne se asal wavelength λ, scattered wavelength λ′ aur scattering angle θ ka rishta milta hai:
Is liye Compton shift ka formula:
Factor h/m₀c ki dimensions wavelength wali hain; ise Compton wavelength kehte hain. Is ki value:

Agar scattered X-ray photons θ = 90° par dekhe jayen to cos 90° = 0, is liye Compton shift Δλ Compton wavelength ke barabar hota hai. Eq. 18.8 Compton ke experimental results (tajurbe ke nataij) se poori tarah mili. Yeh is baat ka zabardast proof (saboot) tha ke electromagnetic waves matter (maddah) se particle ki tarah interact karti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Eq. 18.6' likhti hai; Compton shift ki equation Eq. 18.8 hai (Eq. 18.6 photoelectric threshold wali hai).
Is effect ki discovery (daryaft) par Arthur Holly Compton ko 1927 mein physics ka Nobel Prize mila.

Pichhli class mein hum bohat zyada energy wale photon (jaise γ-ray) aur matter ka ek aur interaction parh chuke hain: pair production. Is mein photon ki energy Einstein ki energy equation ke mutabiq electron-positron pair (jode) mein badal jati hai:

blocks.latex: \text{Energy of photon} = \text{Energy need for pair-production} + K.E.\ \text{of the particles}
blocks.text_alt: Energy of photon = Energy need for pair-production + K.E. of the particles

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: 2m₀c² electron aur positron dono ke rest mass ki energy hai (har ek 0.51 MeV, kul 1.02 MeV). Is se kam energy wala photon pair nahi bana sakta; baqi energy dono particles ki K.E. ban jati hai.
Pair production ka ulat (converse) annihilation of matter kehlata hai: ek particle aur us ka antiparticle mil kar khatam ho jate hain aur γ-rays range ke zyada energy wale photons ban jate hain:

blocks.alt: Oopar: gamma photon (hf) nucleus ke qareeb electron e- (oopar-daen) aur positron e+ (neeche-daen) mein badal jata; hf = 2moc^2 + K.E.(e-) + K.E.(e+). Neeche: electron aur positron aik doosre ki taraf aa kar opposite directions (ulti simton) mein jane wale do gamma photons mein khatam hote, har aik 0.51 MeV; e- + e+ -> gamma + gamma.
blocks.caption: Pair production aur annihilation (hamari drawing; kitab mein is ki koi figure nahi).
blocks.long_description: Energy aur mass aik doosre mein badal sakte hain: kam az kam 2moc^2 (1.02 MeV) wala photon electron-positron pair (jora) bana sakta hai, aur yeh pair wapas gamma rays mein badal sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: 180° par scattered X-rays ka Compton shift kitna hai?
blocks.explanation: Δλ = (h/m₀c)(1 − cos 180°) = 2 × 2.43 × 10⁻¹² m = 4.86 × 10⁻¹² m. Yeh sab se bara mumkin shift hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Compton effect: scattered X-rays ki wavelength barh jati hai; X-rays photons ki tarah electron se takrati hain.
Δλ = (h/m₀c)(1 − cos θ) (18.8); Compton wavelength h/m₀c = 2.43 × 10⁻¹² m.
Pair production: hf = 2m₀c² + K.E.(e⁻) + K.E.(e⁺) (18.9); annihilation: e⁻ + e⁺ = γ + γ.
